name: hooks-worktrunk
description: Enforces Worktrunk as the worktree-management interface for Claude and Codex. A cross-runtime PreToolUse guard denies direct git worktree and gh pr checkout commands with the equivalent wt command. Native task agents claim their bead in the parent checkout, create linked worktrees through wt, record the returned branch and absolute path, and work from that path. Claude-only WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove handlers route the native lifecycle through wt.
